sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日资讯简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我们将对部分采访进行直播，供任何人免费在 NYTimes.com 上观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过它的。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日播客》。

sentences.en: The third time this year, a mass shooter has posted his manifesto on 8chan.
sentences.zh: 今年已经是第三次，有大规模枪击案凶手在 8chan 上发布他的宣言了。

sentences.en: The battle over whether to shut the site down.
sentences.zh: 关于是否应该关闭该网站的争论。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 8 月 6 日，星期二。

sentences.en: The Christchurch shooter's specific part of the internet that he came from was a message board called 8chan, and specifically a chunk of 8chan's called Slash Poll.
sentences.zh: 基督城枪击案凶手来自互联网上的特定部分是一个名叫 8chan 的留言板，具体来说是 8chan 中一个叫做 Slash Poll 的板块。

sentences.en: The suspected gunman in Poway posted praise for 8chan just before the shooting, saying,
sentences.zh: 波韦亚枪击案的嫌疑人在枪击发生前不久发布了对 8chan 的赞扬，写道：

sentences.en: I've only been lurking for a year and a half, yet what I've learned here is priceless.
sentences.zh: 我潜水只有一年半，但我在学到的是无价的。

sentences.en: It's been an honor.
sentences.zh: 这是一种荣幸。

sentences.en: We're back with the breaking news, a mass shooting in El Paso, Texas, at the Cielo Vista Mall.
sentences.zh: 我们回来播报突发新闻，德克萨斯州埃尔帕索的西洛维斯塔购物中心发生了一起大规模枪击案。

sentences.en: Minutes before the shooting in El Paso, Texas, the suspect posted his racist anti-immigrant manifesto to the online message board 8chan.
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州埃尔帕索枪击案发生几分钟前，嫌疑人在网络留言板 8chan 上发布了他那充满种族主义和反移民色彩的宣言。

sentences.en: Posted a manifesto on the website 8chan moments before the shooting.
sentences.zh: 在枪击发生前不久，在 8chan 网站上发布了一份宣言。

sentences.en: He posted that hate was his motive on 8chan.
sentences.zh: 他在 8chan 上发帖称仇恨是他的动机。

sentences.en: 8chan claims they deleted the post nine minutes after it was published, but other calls to violence remain.
sentences.zh: 8chan 声称他们在帖子发布九分钟后将其删除，但其他煽动暴力的内容仍然存在。

sentences.en: Kevin Roos, it feels noteworthy that we now routinely turn to our technology columnist, you, after every mass shooting.
sentences.zh: 凯文·罗斯，每次发生大规模枪击案后，我们现在都会例行公事般地转向我们的科技专栏作家——也就是你，这感觉很值得关注。

sentences.en: But tell me where your head went after the news broke this weekend of this shooting in Texas.
sentences.zh: 但请告诉我，当这周末德州枪击案的新闻爆发时，你脑子里想的是什么？

sentences.en: I immediately thought about Frederick Brennan.
sentences.zh: 我立刻想到了弗雷德里克·布伦南。

sentences.en: He's the founder of 8chan, and he was sort of a vocal defender of this community for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他是 8chan 的创始人，而且在很长一段时间里，他可以说是这个社群的公开捍卫者。

sentences.en: And then recently has been expressing some real misgivings about it.
sentences.zh: 而最近，他开始对它表达真正的疑虑。

sentences.en: And he was explicitly calling for the site to be shut down.
sentences.zh: 并且他明确呼吁关闭该网站。

sentences.en: So I wanted to talk to him about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想跟他聊聊这件事。

sentences.en: So I looked him up.
sentences.zh: 于是我查了他的资料。

sentences.en: I got in touch.
sentences.zh: 我取得了联系。

sentences.en: He agreed to talk.
sentences.zh: 他同意交谈。

sentences.en: He would Skype with me from his home in the Philippines.
sentences.zh: 他通过 Skype 从他在菲律宾的家中接受我的采访。

sentences.en: So after getting up on Sunday morning, I went to my computer and I called him on Skype.
sentences.zh: 所以在周日早上起床后，我走到电脑前用 Skype 呼叫了他。

sentences.en: Hey, sorry about the delay on that.
sentences.zh: 嘿，抱歉那个弄晚了。

sentences.en: Yeah, no problem.
sentences.zh: 没事，没问题。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I can only talk for like 20 minutes, so you should put your important questions first, just saying.
sentences.zh: 我只能聊大约 20 分钟，所以你最好把重要的问题先问，先提醒你一下。

sentences.en: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Kevin, he seemed very happy to hear from you.
sentences.zh: 凯文，他接到你的电话似乎很高兴。

sentences.en: Yeah, this was probably not the best part of his day.
sentences.zh: 是的，这可能不是他这一天里最好的一段经历。

sentences.en: You know, it's just really annoying to keep...
sentences.zh: 你知道，一直……真的让人很烦。

sentences.en: And look, it's like people's lives were affected in ways that are much more serious than how my life is affected by it when this happens again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 而且听着，当这种事一次又一次发生时，人们的生活受到的影响，比我因此受到的影响要严重得多。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it's like every single time one of these shootings happens and there is an 8chan connection.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，就像每次发生这种枪击案并且跟 8chan 有关联时一样。

sentences.en: I'm always just dragged into it.
sentences.zh: 我总是会被无端拖进去。

sentences.en: And I know...
sentences.zh: 我知道……

sentences.en: I got the sense that one of the reasons that he is calling for 8chan to be taken down is that it would make his life a lot easier.
sentences.zh: 我有一种感觉，他呼吁查封 8chan 的原因之一是这能让他的生活轻松得多。

sentences.en: He wouldn't have to be involved in explaining 8chan every time there's a mass shooting that involves the site.
sentences.zh: 他不必每次发生涉及该网站的大规模枪击案时，都要出面解释 8chan。

sentences.en: He wouldn't have to field calls from the media.
sentences.zh: 他不必应付媒体的电话。

sentences.en: He could kind of move on with his life and not have this part of his past come up every time it's implicated in one of these mass shootings.
sentences.zh: 他可以继续他的生活，而不必在每次这部分过去被牵扯进这类大规模枪击案时，都被人提起。

sentences.en: You know, as soon as this happened and I saw the original articles that said maybe the shooter posted on 4chan or 8chan, you know, it wasn't clear in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一旦发生这种事，当我看到最初的文章说凶手可能是在 4chan 或 8chan 上发帖时，你知道，一开始并不明朗。

sentences.en: Well, I just very quickly, you know, just opened up a few sites and I was very easily able to determine that it was legitimate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我非常迅速地，你知道的，只是打开了几个网站，非常轻易地就能断定那是真的。

sentences.en: He said that he always has kind of the same routine.
sentences.zh: 他说他总是保持着某种相同的常规。

sentences.en: Whenever there's a mass shooting, he sort of has to go research whether there's an 8chan connection.
sentences.zh: 每当发生大规模枪击案时，他都得去研究一下这是否与 8chan 有关。

sentences.en: And I probably would have done that much faster, but just due to time zones, it was a Sunday, so I was at church instead of doing that research.
sentences.zh: 我本可以更快完成的，但由于时差，那天是星期天，所以我当时在教堂，而不是在做那个研究。

sentences.en: And I decided that was more important than staying here and dealing with it right away.
sentences.zh: 我决定那比留在这里立即处理这事更重要。

sentences.en: He told me that he got up, saw this news, and sort of instead of going through his normal routine of doing all of his research to figure out whether there was an 8chan connection,
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他起床后看到这个消息，没有像往常那样去做所有的研究来弄清楚这是否与 8chan 有关，

sentences.en: he went to church.
sentences.zh: 而是去了教堂。

sentences.en: He sounded like a lot of us.
sentences.zh: 他听起来很像我们中的许多人。

sentences.en: He understands that there's a pattern now.
sentences.zh: 他明白现在已经形成了一种模式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, at the same time, do you feel a sense of frustration with Jim that he won't take you to the site?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，与此同时，你对吉姆不肯把网站交出来有没有感到一丝沮丧？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我确实有。

sentences.en: Kevin, who is Jim?
sentences.zh: 凯文，吉姆是谁？

sentences.en: Jim is Jim Watkins, who's the current owner of 8chan.
sentences.zh: 吉姆是吉姆·沃特金斯，也就是 8chan 的现任所有者。

sentences.en: And he's the guy who, you know, if he wanted to, could take the site down.
sentences.zh: 他就是那个，你知道的，如果他愿意的话，可以把网站关掉的人。

sentences.en: Could do what Frederick wants.
sentences.zh: 可以照着弗雷德里克的意思去做。

sentences.en: Exactly, but he doesn't want to.
sentences.zh: 没错，但他不想。

sentences.en: And I just don't...
sentences.zh: 我只是不……

sentences.en: I've tried to understand so many times why he keeps it going, and I just don't get it.
sentences.zh: 我有太多次试图理解他为什么还要维持这个网站，但我就是搞不懂。

sentences.en: You know, two days ago...
sentences.zh: 你知道，两天前……

sentences.en: And what's the story of these two guys?
sentences.zh: 这两个家伙的故事是怎样的？

sentences.en: So, the story of 8chan goes back to 2013.
sentences.zh: 所以，8chan 的故事可以追溯到 2013 年。

sentences.en: And explaining it well sort of requires explaining this whole kind of internet underbelly.
sentences.zh: 要把它解释清楚，多少需要解释整个互联网的藏污纳垢之地。

sentences.en: So, just bear with me.
sentences.zh: 所以，请多包涵。

sentences.en: There's going to be some weird stuff here.
sentences.zh: 这里会有一些奇怪的东西。

sentences.en: So, Frederick Brennan, you know, was sort of a known figure in this kind of internet underworld.
sentences.zh: 所以，弗雷德里克·布伦南，你知道的，算是互联网底层世界里一个知名人物。

sentences.en: He was a longtime user of 4chan, the sort of bigger, older, more established site.
sentences.zh: 他是 4chan 的长期用户，那是那个更大、更老、更成熟的网站。

sentences.en: He was briefly the administrator of a message board for adult male virgins, which he then had to resign, he said, because he was no longer a virgin.
sentences.zh: 他曾短暂担任过一个面向成年男性处男的留言板管理员，后来他说自己不得不辞职，因为他已经不再是处男了。

sentences.en: He was involved in a lot of other sort of internet communities.
sentences.zh: 他参与了许多其他种类的互联网社群。

sentences.en: And then in 2013, he said that he was high on psychedelic mushrooMs.
sentences.zh: 然后在 2013 年，他说他嗑迷幻蘑菇嗨了。

sentences.en: And he got an idea for a website called Infinite Chan.
sentences.zh: 他想出了一个名为 Infinite Chan 的网站的点子。

sentences.en: And Infinite Chan, he thought, would be sort of like the ultimate free speech, anything goes version of 4chan.
sentences.zh: 他认为，Infinite Chan 将会成为终极版的言论自由、百无禁忌的 4chan。

sentences.en: It would be 4chan with even fewer guardrails.
sentences.zh: 它将是监管更少的 4chan。

sentences.en: And it would be a site that would allow sort of anyone to kind of not only go to this free speech utopia, but to create their own versions of it,
sentences.zh: 它将是一个允许任何人不仅能够访问这个言论自由的乌托邦，还能创建他们自己的版本的网站，

sentences.en: it would kind of be any number of anonymous free-for-all message boards.
sentences.zh: 它基本上可以变成任意数量的匿名无限制自由留言板。

sentences.en: And he called it Infinite Chan.
sentences.zh: 他将其命名为 Infinite Chan。

sentences.en: He uses the infinity symbol, which is, you know, sort of the sideways 8.
sentences.zh: 他使用了无穷大符号，你知道的，也就是横过来的 8。

sentences.en: Thus 8chan.
sentences.zh: 因此叫 8chan。

sentences.en: Hard to type that.
sentences.zh: 那个很难打出来。

sentences.en: So, people just start calling it 8chan.
sentences.zh: 所以，人们开始直接叫它 8chan。

sentences.en: So, the site is not all that popular at firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个网站一开始并不是那么受欢迎。

sentences.en: It's pretty small.
sentences.zh: 它非常小。

sentences.en: Nobody really knows about it.
sentences.zh: 根本没人知道它。

sentences.en: And then in 2014, 8chan kind of gets a lucky break because a bunch of guys sort of affiliated with a movement called Gamergate,
sentences.zh: 然后在 2014 年，8chan 算是走了个运，因为有一群自称与“玩家门”运动有关的人，

sentences.en: which was a kind of reactionary movement of gamers who were upset about sort of social justice warriors, like destroying video games, who had gotten kicked off of 4chan.
sentences.zh: 那是一场游戏玩家的反动运动，他们对那些像是在毁灭电子游戏的社会正义战士感到不满，他们被从 4chan 赶了出来。

sentences.en: They needed a new place to go where there were fewer rules, where they could post whatever they wanted, where they wouldn't be censored or moderated in any way.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一个规则更少、可以随心所欲发帖、而且绝不会被审查或管理的全新去处。

sentences.en: And so, they found 8chan.
sentences.zh: 于是，他们找到了 8chan。

sentences.en: 8chan became kind of the unofficial home of Gamergate.
sentences.zh: 8chan 成为了“玩家门”非官方的大本营。

sentences.en: It sounds like from the very beginning,
sentences.zh: 听上去从一开始，

sentences.en: 8chan is a home to kind of those who nobody else wants to house.
sentences.zh: 8chan 就是那些其他人都不愿意收留的人的家园。

sentences.en: The worst of the worSt.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕中的最糟糕。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: 8chan becomes kind of like the quarantine zone of the internet.
sentences.zh: 8chan 变得有点像是互联网的隔离区。

sentences.en: 8chan has sort of hosted the largest group of QAnon supporters.
sentences.zh: 8chan 曾经托管了最大规模的“匿名者Q”支持者群体。

sentences.en: Incels, various other sort of internet communities that aren't really allowed or encouraged to congregate on other sites, they often set up shop on 8chan.
sentences.zh: 非自愿单身者（Incels）以及其他各种不被允许或不被鼓励在其他网站聚集的互联网社群，他们经常在 8chan 上扎营。

sentences.en: It's kind of the platform of last resort.
sentences.zh: 这算是一个最后手段的平台。

sentences.en: So, how does Jim Watkins come into this picture?
sentences.zh: 那么，吉姆·沃特金斯是怎么卷入这幅画面的？

sentences.en: So, Jim Watkins is a 50-something army veteran who has been living in the Philippines for a number of years.
sentences.zh: 所以，吉姆·沃特金斯是一位五十多岁的退伍军人，在菲律宾生活多年。

sentences.en: He's kind of a libertarian, free speech, you know, absolutist guy.
sentences.zh: 他算是个自由意志主义者、言论自由，你知道的，极端主义者。

sentences.en: And he finds out about 8chan from his son.
sentences.zh: 他从他儿子那里知道了 8chan。

sentences.en: And it sort of strikes him as an interesting project.
sentences.zh: 这让他觉得这是一个有趣的项目。

sentences.en: And he contacts Frederick and basically offers to get involved.
sentences.zh: 于是他联系了弗雷德里克，基本上提出了参与的意愿。

sentences.en: So, Jim has been sort of around technology for a while, his big successful project before 8chan was he ran an Asian porn site.
sentences.zh: 所以，吉姆在科技界混了一段时间，他在 8chan 之前那个大获成功的项目是经营一家亚洲色情网站。

sentences.en: He made some money from that and then formed a technology company.
sentences.zh: 他靠那个赚了一些钱，然后成立了一家科技公司。

sentences.en: So, he had a couple things that Frederick needed.
sentences.zh: 所以他拥有几样弗雷德里克当时需要的东西。

sentences.en: He had money, he had some tech expertise, and he was willing to get involved.
sentences.zh: 他有钱，有一定的技术专长，而且他愿意参与进来。

sentences.en: So, at this point, the two key figures in this site, already designed to be a free speech haven, are an internet troll who didn't think the last site he was on was free enough,
sentences.zh: 所以，到了这个时候，这个从一开始就被设计为言论自由避难所的网站，其两个关键人物是一个认为他上一个待过的网站还不够自由的互联网喷子，

sentences.en: and the founder of a porn site.
sentences.zh: 以及一个色情网站的创始人。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In 2014, Frederick decides to actually move to the Philippines to work with Jim on 8chan.
sentences.zh: 2014 年，弗雷德里克决定真正搬到菲律宾，与吉姆一起开发 8chan。

sentences.en: So, he leaves New York, he moves to the Philippines, and they start working together on building 8chan into something bigger and better.
sentences.zh: 于是他离开纽约，搬到菲律宾，他们开始合作将 8chan 打造得更大更好。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，去看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, where do things go wrong in this partnership?
sentences.zh: 那么，这段合作关系是在哪里出了问题？

sentences.en: So, I'm not exactly sure what happened between Frederick and Jim, but at some point, there was a rift.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不太确定弗雷德里克和吉姆之间到底发生了什么，但在某个时候，出现了一条裂痕。

sentences.en: They had disagreements, they sort of had a falling out, and last year, they formally split.
sentences.zh: 他们产生了分歧，闹翻了，并在去年正式分道扬镳。

sentences.en: Frederick left Jim's company, no longer has anything to do with 8chan.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德里克离开了吉姆的公司，跟 8chan 再无任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: And that sort of coincides with the rise of these mass shootings.
sentences.zh: 而这恰好与这些大规模枪击案的激增时间吻合。

sentences.en: And so, Frederick then starts this kind of public campaign against Jim and 8chan, and he becomes one of the most vocal critics of the site and of its ownership.
sentences.zh: 于是，弗雷德里克随后针对吉姆和 8chan 发起了一场公开运动，他成为了该网站及其所有权最直言不讳的批评者之一。

sentences.en: And he moved to the Philippines to work with Jim, but he's stayed there.
sentences.zh: 他搬到菲律宾是为了和吉姆一起工作，但他留在了那里。

sentences.en: He never moved back.
sentences.zh: 他再也没有搬回去。

sentences.en: So, he still lives in the Philippines, actually quite close to Jim.
sentences.zh: 所以他依然住在菲律宾，其实离吉姆很近。

sentences.en: And they're not really speaking, but he's now become this kind of prominent thorn in Jim's side as he tries to run 8chan.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上不说话了，但当吉姆试图运营 8chan 时，他现在成了扎在吉姆心头的一根显眼的刺。

sentences.en: It's funny because, like, okay, on my way to church, I pass by where he lives.
sentences.zh: 这就很有趣，因为，好吧，在我去教堂的路上，我会路过他住的地方。

sentences.en: So, it's like, always when I pass by there, it's like, oh.
sentences.zh: 所以每次我路过那里，就会想，哦。

sentences.en: Because I have a very, let's just say it's like a very noticeable car.
sentences.zh: 因为我有一辆，这么说吧，非常显眼的汽车。

sentences.en: It's like a very unique color because I had it colored that way.
sentences.zh: 它有一种非常独特的颜色，因为我特意把它喷成那个样子的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just very unique.
sentences.zh: 是的，就是非常独特。

sentences.en: So, I know that they have probably noticed me driving by before because there's many people in that household, you know, and he has a driver, he has a maid, he has a wife,
sentences.zh: 所以我知道他们以前可能注意到我开车路过，因为那个宅子里有很多人，你知道的，他有司机，有女佣，还有妻子，

sentences.en: he has kids.
sentences.zh: 他有孩子。

sentences.en: So, there's probably at any one time somebody looking out the window and seeing, you know, my car.
sentences.zh: 所以，可能随时有人会往窗外看，你知道的，看到我的车。

sentences.en: And so, he thinks, you know, someone is probably seeing him drive paSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，他会觉得，你知道的，可能有人看到他开车经过。

sentences.en: It's probably kind of a visual reminder to Jim that Frederick is there in pretty close proximity giving him a hard time about 8chan.
sentences.zh: 对吉姆来说，这可能算是一种视觉上的提醒，提醒他弗雷德里克就在非常近的地方，为了8chan的事一直在给他找麻烦。

sentences.en: Yes, and you know, another thing about it is they still have that stupid saying on the front of the site, embrace infamy.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且你知道的，关于这件事还有一点，他们在网站首页依然挂着那个愚蠢的标语，拥抱恶名。

sentences.en: It's like they think this is funny.
sentences.zh: 感觉他们觉得这挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: You know, I never had that on there and you can check the archives to see that that's true.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我的网站上从来没有过这个，你可以去查查档案，就能证明这是真的。

sentences.en: That embrace infamy thing is their thing.
sentences.zh: 那个“拥抱恶名”的东西是他们的风格。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's like after Christchurch, after the Tree of Life shooting, and now after this shooting, it's still there.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，就好像在克赖斯特彻奇枪击案之后、生命之树犹太教堂枪击案之后，现在又在这起枪击案之后，它依然挂在那里。

sentences.en: It's like they think that this is all really funny.
sentences.zh: 感觉他们觉得这一切真的非常搞笑。

sentences.en: Oh, we're infamous.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们恶名昭彰。

sentences.en: We're, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们，你知道的，

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm just very frustrated.
sentences.zh: 我只是感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: So, it sounds like there is more to his desire to get this site shut down than his frustration with the attention that comes to him after these shootings
sentences.zh: 所以，听起来他渴望关闭这个网站，不仅仅是因为这些枪击案给他带来的关注让他感到烦恼，

sentences.en: or his grievances with Jim Watkins, that he is genuinely troubled and upset by what's happening on the site.
sentences.zh: 或者他对吉姆·沃特金斯的怨恨，而是他对网站上发生的事情感到由衷的困扰和心烦。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think he really is disturbed by what has been happening on 8chan.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得他确实对8chan上一直在发生的事情感到不安。

sentences.en: Do you agree with people who say that it's become sort of a haven for terrorist incitement?
sentences.zh: 你是否同意那些认为这里已经成为恐怖主义煽动避风港的说法？

sentences.en: I mean, certain boards, yes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，某些板块确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And specifically on a section of this site that's about politics called P.O.L.
sentences.zh: 特别是网站上一个关于政治的板块，叫做P.O.L。

sentences.en: P.O.L.
sentences.zh: P.O.L.

sentences.en: Yeah, P.O.L., you know, the other news boards also to a degree, but of course, P.O.L.
sentences.zh: 对，P.O.L.，你知道的，其他新闻板块在某种程度上也是如此，但当然，P.O.L.

sentences.en: is the biggest one.
sentences.zh: 是最大的一个。

sentences.en: That's where a lot of these mass shooters have been going.
sentences.zh: 很多这类大规模枪击案的凶手就是从那里去的。

sentences.en: And there's a culture in P.O.L.
sentences.zh: 而且在P.O.L.有一种文化，

sentences.en: of kind of celebrating these mass shooters while they're carrying out the mass shootings and afterward.
sentences.zh: 就是在这些大规模枪击案凶手行凶时以及事后，对他们进行某种庆祝。

sentences.en: So, you know, for example, after the synagogue shooting in California earlier this year, there was a thread on Paul that was basically egging this shooter on.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，比如今年早些时候加州犹太教堂枪击案发生后，保罗论坛上有一个帖子基本上是在煽动这个枪手。

sentences.en: And these people were saying they hoped he could beat the high score of the New Zealand shooter, by which he meant killing more people than the New Zealand shooter.
sentences.zh: 这些人说他们希望他能打破新西兰枪手的最高纪录，他们的意思是杀的人比新西兰枪手还要多。

sentences.en: I would characterize it as kind of the worst, most vile part of the worst, most vile website.
sentences.zh: 我会把它形容为最糟糕、最恶劣的网站中最糟糕、最恶劣的部分。

sentences.en: I'm not saying that they caused the shooting, but 8chan is definitely highly implicated.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说他们导致了枪击案，但8chan绝对脱不了干系。

sentences.en: And so I think Frederick is really disturbed.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为弗雷德里克真的很困扰。

sentences.en: And he's not only disturbed that there's this kind of culture of celebrating mass shooters and lionizing them, he's also disturbed by kind of how 8chan is being used
sentences.zh: 他不仅对这种庆祝和美化大规模枪击凶手的文化感到不安，还对8chan被用作

sentences.en: as a kind of archiving service.
sentences.zh: 某种档案存储服务感到不安。

sentences.en: When potential shooters saw how successful it was to post on 8chan, because in the past, it was like they would post on Facebook only or Twitter only,
sentences.zh: 当潜在的枪手看到在8chan上发帖有多成功时——因为过去，他们只在Facebook或Twitter上发帖，

sentences.en: and the tech companies would suppress it really fast, and there would be no archive.
sentences.zh: 而科技公司会以极快的速度将其删除，而且不会留下任何档案。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, it would not spread.
sentences.zh: 就像，它不会传播开来。

sentences.en: You would not be able to find...
sentences.zh: 你将无法找到……

sentences.en: And that happened a few times where the manifesto did not become public domain.
sentences.zh: 这种情况发生过好几次，宣言没有成为公开资料。

sentences.en: But it's like when they saw, oh, wow, these 8chan users, they're good with computers.
sentences.zh: 但当他们看到，哦，哇，这些8chan的用户，他们很懂电脑。

sentences.en: They love shooters.
sentences.zh: 他们太喜欢枪手了。

sentences.en: They ripped that live stream from Facebook in, like, minutes.
sentences.zh: 他们在几分钟内就从Facebook上把那个直播视频给扒下来了。

sentences.en: Like, if he had just posted it on Facebook and maybe, like, read it to, like, more normal sites, I don't think anybody would have ripped it.
sentences.zh: 如果他只是把它发到Facebook上，或者可能把它发到一些更正常的网站上，我觉得根本没人会去扒它。

sentences.en: I don't think that would have gotten out there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这根本传不出去。

sentences.en: Just saying.
sentences.zh: 我只是这么一说。

sentences.en: You know, people say the internet is forever, but it's kind of not.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们说互联网是有记忆的，但其实也并非如此。

sentences.en: It's kind of not, like, among normal people, you know?
sentences.zh: 在普通人中间，其实也并非如此，你知道吗？

sentences.en: But, Kevin, even if Frederick succeeded in getting Jim to take down 8chan, couldn't another site fulfill that role he's describing to you?
sentences.zh: 但是，凯文，即使弗雷德里克成功让吉姆关闭了8chan，难道就不会有另一个网站来扮演他向你描述的那种角色吗？

sentences.en: And wouldn't another website pop up to fulfill that role instantly?
sentences.zh: 难道不会瞬间冒出另一个网站来扮演这个角色吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全会。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, we talked about this.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我们讨论过这个。

sentences.en: I'm not even saying that if 8chan is shut down that this kind of thing would stop.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不是说如果8chan被关了，这种事就会停止。

sentences.en: There's obviously a problem in American society that shutting down 8chan is not going to fix because the society gave rise to 8chan and it'll give rise to something else, right?
sentences.zh: 美国社会显然存在一个问题，关闭8chan是无法解决的，因为正是这个社会孕育了8chan，它也会孕育出别的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I'm not politically ignorant enough to think that, oh, we shut down 8chan, it's all over.
sentences.zh: 就像，我还没愚蠢到认为只要关掉8chan就万事大吉了。

sentences.en: Obviously, that's not true.
sentences.zh: 显然，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: But he does think that if Jim took down 8chan, there wouldn't really be something that popped up to replace it exactly as it is, with the same kind of culture
sentences.zh: 但他确实认为，如果吉姆关掉了8chan，就不会真的有什么东西能够冒出来完全取代它，不会有那种相同的文化，

sentences.en: of tolerating and celebrating violence, with the same unmoderated structure.
sentences.zh: 那种容忍和庆祝暴力、没有任何版主管理的结构。

sentences.en: It wouldn't necessarily totally stop these kind of things from happening, but it wouldn't happen every few months.
sentences.zh: 这不一定会彻底阻止这类事情发生，但它不会每隔几个月就发生一次。

sentences.en: It would be more rare.
sentences.zh: 它会变得更少见。

sentences.en: I just feel like it would really slow things down if there wasn't a big clearnet site that, like, you can just open a browser and type a few numbers and letters and get there.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，如果没有一个大型明网网站——那种你打开浏览器，输入几个数字和字母就能访问的网站，事情真的会慢下来。

sentences.en: The internet is sort of divided into the clearnet and the dark web.
sentences.zh: 互联网大体上分为明网和暗网。

sentences.en: So the clearnet is, you know, sites that you and I visit.
sentences.zh: 所以明网就是，你知道的，你和我访问的网站。

sentences.en: It's, you know, anything that you can get to in a normal web browser with a normal internet connection is considered to be part of the clearnet.
sentences.zh: 它是，你知道的，任何你通过普通网络浏览器和普通网络连接就能访问的东西，都被认为是明网的一部分。

sentences.en: The dark web is a different set of websites that you need special tools to access, including a browser called Tor.
sentences.zh: 暗网是另一组需要特殊工具才能访问的网站，其中包括一个叫做Tor的浏览器。

sentences.en: I feel like if it was pushed into Tor, it would be harder for people to get to these chan sites.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果它被逼到Tor上，人们想要接触到这些“嵌”网站就会变得更难。

sentences.en: That would make it much harder to access for the casual person who doesn't want to go through a whole lot of steps to get there.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不想经历繁琐步骤的普通人来说，访问门槛会大大提高。

sentences.en: You know, teenagers would have to learn a bunch of computer stuff, learn about Tor, learn about networking, you know, to be able to access these kind of sites.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，青少年必须学习一堆电脑知识，了解Tor，了解网络，你知道的，才能访问这类网站。

sentences.en: That it would kind of put more friction into the process of discovering these sort of violent extremist communities.
sentences.zh: 这会在发现这些暴力极端主义社群的过程中增加更多的阻力。

sentences.en: This wouldn't happen as often.
sentences.zh: 这种情况就不会发生得那么频繁了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, maybe my reasons are partially selfish.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，也许我的理由带有部分自私的成分。

sentences.en: And, obviously, American society is screwed.
sentences.zh: 而且，显然，美国社会已经完蛋了。

sentences.en: But, um...
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯……

sentences.en: Yes, I think it would help to a degree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得在某种程度上会有所帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do we have any reason to believe that the shooting in El Paso might end with Frederick getting what he wants here, which is 8chan coming down?
sentences.zh: 我们有什么理由相信，埃尔帕索的枪击案可能会以弗雷德里克如愿以偿、也就是8chan被关闭而告终呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think there are sort of two ways that this could be accomplished.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为可以通过大约两种途径来实现这一点。

sentences.en: The first way for 8chan to come down would be basically for it to get evicted from the internet by all of the sort of service providers, the web hosts, the DNS registrars,
sentences.zh: 让8chan倒闭的第一种途径，基本上就是被所有的服务提供商、网络托管商、域名注册商从互联网上驱逐出去，

sentences.en: the various, like, middlemen who allow websites to get online and stay online.
sentences.zh: 也就是那些让网站得以在线并保持在线的各种中间商。

sentences.en: And, actually, today we've already seen a lot of that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，今天我们已经看到了很多这样的情况。

sentences.en: So 8chan is down right now in part because Cloudflare, one of the companies that is sort of a provider of services, security services to 8chan, pulled it off its platform
sentences.zh: 所以8chan现在无法访问，部分原因是Cloudflare——作为向8chan提供服务的公司之一、为其提供安全服务的公司——将它从自己的平台上移除了，

sentences.en: because of the mass shooting.
sentences.zh: 就因为那场大规模枪击案。

sentences.en: Another site that it tried to go to as a result of that was also pulled offline by its provider.
sentences.zh: 它因被驱逐而尝试投奔的另一个网站，也同样被其服务商勒令下线。

sentences.en: So they're sort of casting around looking for a new home.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在到处寻找新的栖身之所。

sentences.en: Somebody somewhere will probably host it.
sentences.zh: 总归某处会有人愿意托管它的。

sentences.en: And then there's this obvious, sort of more direct way to get it taken down, which would be if Jim decided to take it down.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一种显而易见的、更直接的让它下线的方式，那就是如果吉姆决定亲手把它关掉。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's the only way to guarantee that 8chan is down for good, is for Jim Watkins to take it down.
sentences.zh: 这是确保8chan彻底永久下线的唯一方法，那就是由吉姆·沃特金斯把它关掉。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, and, like, if you could send him a message after this latest shooting, like, what would you tell him or what will you tell him?
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，如果你能在这次最新的枪击案发生后给他发条消息，你会跟他说什么，或者你会告诉他什么？

sentences.en: Like, what's the message?
sentences.zh: 也就是，你想传达什么信息？

sentences.en: I mean, I think the best message is the one I sent this morning before, you know, I went to church to try to calm down.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得最好的信息就是我今天早上发的那个，你知道的，在我去教堂试图让自己平静下来之前。

sentences.en: It's just shut the site down.
sentences.zh: 那就是把网站关了吧。

sentences.en: It's not doing the world any good.
sentences.zh: 它对这个世界没有半点好处。

sentences.en: It is a complete negative to everybody except the users that are there.
sentences.zh: 除了那上面的用户，它对所有人都是个彻头彻尾的负面存在。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's a negative to them, too.
sentences.zh: 它对那些用户来说也是个负面存在。

sentences.en: They just don't realize it.
sentences.zh: 他们只是自己没有意识到罢了。

sentences.en: This is a personal question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很私人的问题。

sentences.en: I don't know what kind of church you go to or how you express your faith, but do you feel like you are looking for forgiveness for some part of your past?
sentences.zh: 我不知道你去的是哪种教堂，也不知道你如何表达你的信仰，但你觉得你是在为自己过去的某些经历寻求宽恕吗？

sentences.en: I was fishing a little bit here because I don't really know the story, but I do know that he became a pretty religious Christian in the Philippines,
sentences.zh: 我这么说有点旁敲侧击的意思，因为我其实并不了解这个故事，但我确实知道他后来在菲律宾成了一名相当虔诚的基督徒，

sentences.en: and I just wanted to know, like, what's that about?
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，这到底是是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And what did he say?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么说的？

sentences.en: He sort of thought about it and said, you know...
sentences.zh: 他稍微思考了一下，然后说，你知道的……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, in a way, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，在某种程度上，当然。

sentences.en: I mean, we all should seek forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们都应该寻求宽恕。

sentences.en: Maybe you have a point, and then it sort of, like, sounded like he hadn't been asked about it before, hadn't really thought about it.
sentences.zh: 也许你说得有道理，然后听起来好像以前没人问过他这个问题，他自己也没怎么想过。

sentences.en: But I'm just saying, like,
sentences.zh: 但我只是想说，

sentences.en: yeah, maybe you're right, but I go every Sunday, so it's not like I saw this happen, and then I'm like, oh, I better go to church for forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 对，也许你是对的，但我每个星期天都去，所以并不是说我看到这事发生了，然后就觉得，哦，我最好去教堂寻求宽恕。

sentences.en: No, it wasn't like that at all because it's like I go there every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 不，根本不是这样的，因为我本来就每个星期天都去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But then again, at the beginning of your interview, he said, I needed to go to church because I don't want to have to think about this latest mass shooting.
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，在采访刚开始时，他说过，我需要去教堂，因为我不想去想最近发生的大规模枪击案。

sentences.en: And here he's saying to you, yeah, there's something to that.
sentences.zh: 而在这里他对你说，是的，这话确实有道理。

sentences.en: I mean, this is clearly a person wrestling with his own culpability.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这显然是一个正在与自身的负罪感作斗争的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, I certainly would interpret it that way.
sentences.zh: 是的，我绝对会这么解读。

sentences.en: Do you think you're ever going to be able to escape it, Chan?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你有一天能摆脱它吗，关于Chan？

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: I remain optimistic that I will
sentences.zh: 我依然保持乐观，觉得我会

sentences.en: just be such a thorn in their side that they will shut it down.
sentences.zh: 成为他们眼中挥之不去的钉子，直到他们把网站关掉。

sentences.en: I have to remain optimistic that this is not going to keep happening until, like, 2030 or 2040.
sentences.zh: 我必须保持乐观，相信这种事不会一直发生到2030年或2040年。

sentences.en: I don't know if I could deal with that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己能不能应付得了那种情况。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Frederick, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德里克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: I'll let you know about the podcast, too.
sentences.zh: 关于播客的事我也会通知你的。

sentences.en: It's kind of this incredible image here.
sentences.zh: 这里的画面真是不可思议。

sentences.en: You have this American living in the Philippines, watching from a distance as this site that he built is playing this horrific role in mass shootings back in the United States.
sentences.zh: 一个美国人住在菲律宾，远距离地看着他一手建立的网站在美国本土的大规模枪击案中扮演着如此可怕的角色。

sentences.en: And the one guy he thinks can actually do something about it is right down the street from him, also watching all of this from afar.
sentences.zh: 而他认为唯一能对此采取实际行动的人，就住在离他几个街区远的地方，也同样在远处注视着这一切。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a very strange detail in a very sad and strange story.
sentences.zh: 是的，在一个极其悲伤而离奇的故事中，这是一个非常离奇的细节。

sentences.en: Kevin, thank you.
sentences.zh: 凯文，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 接下来是今天你需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: My fellow Americans, this morning, our nation is overcome with shock, horror, and sorrow.
sentences.zh: 同胞们，今天早晨，我们的国家被震惊、恐惧和悲痛所笼罩。

sentences.en: This weekend, more than 80 people were killed or wounded in two evil attacks.
sentences.zh: 这个周末，在两起恶性袭击事件中，有80多人伤亡。

sentences.en: In a speech on Monday,
sentences.zh: 在周一的一场演讲中，

sentences.en: President Trump condemned the mass shootings in Texas and Ohio,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统谴责了发生在德克萨斯州和俄亥俄州的大规模枪击案，

sentences.en: singling out the gunmen in El Paso who deliberately targeted immigrants.
sentences.zh: 并特意点名了埃尔帕索枪击案中蓄意针对移民的枪手。

sentences.en: The shooter in El Paso posted a manifesto online consumed by racist hate.
sentences.zh: 埃尔帕索的枪手在网上发布了一份充斥着种族仇恨的宣言。

sentences.en: In one voice, our nation must condemn racism, bigotry, and white supremacy.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家必须万众一心，谴责种族主义、偏执和白人至上主义。

sentences.en: These sinister ideologies must be defeated.
sentences.zh: 这些险恶的意识形态必须被击败。

sentences.en: Hate has no place in America.
sentences.zh: 仇恨在美国没有容身之地。

sentences.en: Trump called on the FBI to take whatever steps necessary to disrupt hate crimes and called for better ways to keep guns out of the hands of the mentally ill.
sentences.zh: 特朗普呼吁FBI采取一切必要措施打击仇恨犯罪，并呼吁采取更好的方法防止精神病患者获得枪支。

sentences.en: But he made no mention of new gun laws.
sentences.zh: 但他对新的枪支法闭口不谈。

sentences.en: Mental illness and hatred pulls the trigger, not the gun.
sentences.zh: 扣动扳机的是精神疾病和仇恨，而不是枪支本身。

sentences.en: And the trade war between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国与中国的贸易战在周一进入了一个危险的新阶段，

sentences.en: and China entered a dangerous new phase on Monday when China allowed the value of its currency to hit a record low compared with the dollar.
sentences.zh: 当时中国允许其货币汇率跌至兑美元的历史新低。

sentences.en: China's currency is tightly controlled and its leaders left little doubt that they had deliberately dropped its value as a countermeasure to President Trump's latest tariffs.
sentences.zh: 中国的货币受到严格管控，其领导层毫不掩饰地表明，他们主动让人民币贬值，以此作为对特朗普总统最新关税政策的反制措施。

sentences.en: A lower Chinese currency hurts the U.S.
sentences.zh: 人民币贬值对美国不利。

sentences.en: by making Chinese imports more affordable to American consumers and making U.S.
sentences.zh: 通过使中国进口商品对美国消费者而言更加实惠，同时让美国

sentences.en: exports more expensive to Chinese consumers.
sentences.zh: 出口商品对中国消费者而言更加昂贵。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了许多自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时又惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 您可以在各大播客平台收听。
